pages.observed: Five samples 0.0 to 0.8 s of a vertical airport curb scene: phone map card top left, airport sign right, white sedan partially visible at left edge, suitcase and bench, skyline behind, dark road below. Caption appears from 0.6 s reading Anyone in San Antonio can now hail a Waymo with no driver,
Samples 1.0 to 1.8 s: the white car with roof pod glides right into the marked bay with red brake lamp lit and slows. Phone still reads Ride requested Finding a car. Caption unchanged on lower road.

Samples 2.0 to 2.8 s: exterior car settles, a small Texas outline card appears, then a cut at 2.4 s to the cab interior with an empty driver seat and a steering wheel that turns by itself; phone card remains overlaid at left and caption stays.
Samples 3.0 to 3.8 s inside the cab: no one in the seats, wheel turning on its own, scenery sliding past the windshield, a Texas locator card tracing its outline. Phone card and caption remain.

Samples 4.0 to 4.8 s: cab interior with empty seats continues, then at 4.8 s a cut to the curb exterior where the white car sits at the bay and a large tilted phone reading Ride requested Finding a car fills the left foreground. Caption box has gone at 4.8 s.

Samples 5.0 to 5.8 s: large phone in foreground, white car partly hidden behind it at the bay. At 5.6 s the phone status flips to Arriving At the curb and the car marker reaches the pin. Caption now reads the airport included.

Samples 6.0 to 6.8 s: the phone holds on Arriving At the curb beside the parked car, caption gone after 6.0 s, then at 6.8 s a cut to a cream grid map on a wooden table with three small pins and a February calendar page. Locator card persists.

Samples 7.0 to 7.8 s: map on table with a February calendar page. For the first 0.6 s nothing changes on the map, then blue river strokes and tan road lines start to draw in. Caption reads The service began in February.

Samples 8.0 to 8.8 s: the map keeps drawing, blue rivers lengthen and a tan oval ring road traces around the three pins and radial roads. Texas locator fades out. Caption still The service began in February.

Samples 9.0 to 9.8 s: the map enlarges to fill the frame, a tag reading 60 square miles Limited area lands on it, the February page slides across, and a black outline begins tracing near the tag. Caption changes to in a limited area of sixty square miles. at 9.4 s.

Samples 10.0 to 10.8 s: the black outline draws around the three pins in a ring and at 10.8 s closes into a shaded polygon. Tag reads 60 square miles Limited area, February page rests at lower left, caption in a limited area of sixty square miles.
Samples 11.0 to 11.8 s: the shaded polygon, tag and calendar page hold still as a completed result for about 1 s while the caption continues. No new motion visible.

Samples 12.0 to 12.8 s: map holds until a cut at 12.4 s to a top-down creek with brown water, pale ripple bands, green bank and trees, and a white car roof with foam at its right end. Disclosure label changes to A different car, April 20th account. Car barely moves during these samples.

Samples 13.0 to 13.8 s: the white car roof sits still on the bank edge while subtle ripple bands move in the brown water. The caption says the Waymo was swept into Salado Creek but the car is not yet moved by the current in these samples.

Samples 14.0 to 14.8 s: the car starts sliding sideways in the current, drifting left and rotating a few degrees, then the view shifts at 14.8 s showing the car lower right and a pale ledge and tree on the upper bank.
Samples 15.0 to 15.8 s: the white car is carried sideways downstream, rotating and growing toward the lens, with a shadow offset and wake lines. By 15.8 s it is leaving frame left. Caption stays.

Samples 16.0 to 16.8 s: the car is carried out of the left edge of frame by 16.4 s, leaving an empty creek with pale current bands and the bank; caption disappears at 16.6 s. Last 0.4 s shows only water.

Samples 17.0 to 17.8 s: the empty creek holds two samples, then at 17.4 s a cut to a flooded neighborhood street where a white car with roof pod sits in brown water beside bungalows, tree and street sign. Disclosure label changes. Caption appears at 17.6 s.

Samples 18.0 to 18.8 s: the same car drifts slowly right while the brown water climbs up the wheels until only the upper tyres and body show. Street, houses and tree hold still. No hazard lamp blinking visible yet.

Samples 19.0 to 19.8 s: the car sits low in the brown water, amber hazard lamps blink on at 19.2 s, and at 19.8 s the view cuts to a closer shot with a blurred background showing the car with its cabin windows and water at the sills.

Samples 20.0 to 20.8 s: closer side view of the stranded white car sitting low in brown water with empty cabin, hazard lamps blinking at both ends, ripples around the sills and a blurred background. Car is otherwise still.
Samples 21.0 to 21.8 s: the stranded white car with empty cabin stays in brown water with hazard lamps pulsing; caption goes off at 21.4 s leaving the picture alone. Only the lamps change.

Samples 22.0 to 22.8 s: last flood frame, then a cut at 22.2 s to a cream card headed Federal recall record, Vehicle safety recall lying on a desk with a pen, sliding in then settling, a text cursor appearing in a field row. Caption Waymo filed a software recall appears at 22.6 s.
Samples 23.0 to 23.8 s: the card's field rows write in, first Recall type Software then Potential units affected 3,791, with a text cursor. Caption Waymo filed a software recall stays.

Samples 24.0 to 24.8 s: the completed card holds still for about 0.7 s, then at 24.8 s the view changes to a card above a grid of dashed car slots that begin filling with small white car icons and a stamp tool at the right edge. Caption changes to that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars.

Samples 25.0 to 25.8 s: the icon grid fills with white car icons, rows two to five filling in order, while a forearm holding a wooden stamp slides in from the right and moves across the top of the card. Caption reads that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars.

Samples 26.0 to 26.8 s: grid is complete, a tag reading Nearly 3,800 vehicles 3,791 potentially affected in the record drops in, and the hand presses a stamp leaving an orange Software recall mark on the card, then lifts away. Caption unchanged.
Samples 27.0 to 27.8 s: stamp hand withdraws, then the stamped card, tag and full car grid hold still as a completed result; caption goes off at 27.6 s. No new motion for about 0.8 s.

Samples 28.0 to 28.8 s: after the stamped record, a cut at 28.2 s to a flat roadway with grass and skyline where the white car drives in from left with small wake lines. A quote card with the recall sentence fades in at upper left. Disclosure label reads The recall wording, not a recorded event.

Samples 29.0 to 29.8 s: the car drives along a dark roadway with lane dashes scrolling past and a recall quote card above. No water on the road is shown yet and no brake lamps visible in these samples.
Samples 30.0 to 30.8 s: the car's brake lamp lights and it slows while a gray standing-water puddle spans in from the right edge of the lane toward it. Quote card and caption unchanged.

Samples 31.0 to 31.8 s: the wide lane shot holds with the car slowed and the puddle still at the right edge, then at 31.6 s a cut to a large close side view of the car with wake ripples at its wheels and the puddle edge entering at right. Caption becomes then drive into standing water on higher speed roads.

Samples 32.0 to 32.8 s: close side view of the car with the puddle edge advancing from the right toward its nose; at 32.8 s the word may highlights in amber on the quote card. The car has not yet entered the water.

Samples 33.0 to 33.8 s: the car rolls into the gray water, ripples and wake lines form at the front wheel, and the word may stays amber highlighted on the quote card while the caption says then drive into standing water on higher speed roads.
Samples 34.0 to 34.8 s: the car keeps rolling through standing water with wake lines, droplets and reflection; no stop or crash is drawn. The may word remains amber highlighted.

Samples 35.0 to 35.8 s: the car-in-water shot holds to 35.4 s, then cuts at 35.6 s to the large recall card with Software recall stamp and 3,791 field, with a blank area below where the remedy row will appear. Caption The federal record says the remedy is currently under development. begins at 35.8 s.

Samples 36.0 to 36.8 s: the Remedy row types in on the record card, reading The remedy is currently under development., highlighted in peach, and a hand with a pen enters from the right toward it. Caption matches.

Samples 37.0 to 37.8 s: a pen points at the highlighted remedy row for about 0.8 s with little change, then at 37.8 s the card enlarges a little and a second arm with a wooden stamp enters from lower right.

Samples 38.0 to 38.8 s: a forearm holding a wooden stamp hovers over the lower row, presses at 38.6 s, and a partly covered orange under-development stamp mark begins to appear at 38.8 s while the pen hand stays on the row.
Samples 39.0 to 39.8 s: the orange Under development stamp mark sits on the remedy row; the stamp hand and pen hand withdraw to the right and the card holds. Caption ends at 39.4 s.

Samples 40.0 to 40.8 s: a new scene of four white cars in a row on a wet lot with fence and tree, a wire with a Vehicle maps card and a small April calendar page. A Weather limits tightened tag slides in from the left and hangs on the wire. Caption As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits, appears at 40.4 s.
Samples 41.0 to 41.8 s: the Weather limits tightened tag with cloud and rain icon slides along the wire above the row of white cars while the cars stay still. Caption unchanged.
Samples 42.0 to 42.8 s: the weather tag only sways slightly on the wire above four still cars. Nothing else changes in the 1 s window. Caption unchanged.

Samples 43.0 to 43.8 s: the wide lot holds still for 0.6 s, then at 43.6 s a cut to a lower, closer view of the same row of white cars with the tag, maps card and April page overhead. Caption changes to and every affected car had the update by April twentieth. No check marks yet.

Samples 44.0 to 44.8 s: circular badges above the cars in the row fill with check marks one after another from front to rear as the caption says every affected car had the update. The April page shows no date number yet.

Samples 45.0 to 45.8 s: all four cars show check badges, the Vehicle maps updated card gains a check, and the picture then holds with nothing new. The April calendar page still shows blank lines instead of a visible date.

Samples 46.0 to 46.8 s: the April calendar page flips and shows the number 20, after the cars' checks have completed. Caption and every affected car had the update by April twentieth. is on screen. Small calendar at the right edge.

Samples 47.0 to 47.8 s: the completed check row with April 20 holds without new motion for about 0.6 s, then at 47.8 s a cut back to the airport curb scene with a phone reading Arriving At the curb and the white car in the bay. New disclosure label A generic airport ride, not the flood cars.
Samples 48.0 to 48.8 s: the white car waits in the bay, then its rear door swings open from 48.4 s. Phone reads Arriving At the curb. Caption So the airport ride is open, appears at the start.
Samples 49.0 to 49.8 s: the car stays in the bay with its rear door open and the phone on Arriving At the curb. Nothing else moves for about 0.8 s. Caption ends before 49.8 s.

Samples 50.0 to 50.8 s: a wider curb view with the white car's door open and a small recall card lying on the road surface reading The remedy is currently under development with an Under development stamp. Card edges drift slightly. Caption and the federal record lists the flood remedy appears at 50.2 s.

Samples 51.0 to 51.8 s: the recall card enlarges and eases toward the lower left foreground below the still car at the curb, remedy text readable at feed scale. Caption continues and the federal record lists the flood remedy.
Samples 52.0 to 52.8 s: the curb with the open-door car and the foreground recall card hold with only a slight card drift. Caption changes to as currently under development. at 52.8 s.

Samples 53.0 to 53.8 s: the film shows the curb ride on top and the record card plus a small phone reading Arriving At the curb on a desk below. A black underline slowly draws under under development on the remedy row. Caption as currently under development.

Samples 54.0 to 54.8 s: a held split composition of the open-door car at the curb above the recall card with its remedy row underlined and stamped Under development, a phone below. No motion. Caption present only in the first sample.
Samples 55.0 to 55.8 s: the final split composition holds with no motion and no caption, the car with open door above and the card marked Under development below.

Samples 56.0 to 56.8 s: the film cuts to a dark credit card, fading up the Texas flag icon, Texas AI Docket wordmark, URL and four credit lines for sources, illustration, map and music. Text is small but legible on the sampled page.
Samples 57.0 to 57.8 s: identical static credit card with the same flag, wordmark, URL and four credit blocks, readable at the sampled size.
Samples 58.0 to 58.8 s: the identical static credit card continues unchanged.
Samples 59.0 to 59.8 s: identical static credit card, unchanged.
Samples 60.0 to 60.8 s: identical static credit card, unchanged.
Final single frame at 60.967 s: the same static dark credits card, complete, with all credit lines readable. This ends the sequence.
